# cjwt provenance

- Upstream: https://github.com/xmidt-org/cjwt
- Version: 2.3.0
- Imported from local TurboHTTP commit: `38f1e389b3f94909db6cb2482a8cbc16522e7e4f`
- License: Apache-2.0 (the SPDX headers remain in every imported source file)

This private Flowie copy contains only the JWS/JWK surface used by the control-plane JWT
authenticator. Local changes replace TurboParser with Salts JsonParser and deliberately
reject the unused JWE code path.

The Salts Crypto JWS backend (`src/jws_salts.c` and `src/jws.h`) is imported from
qigao/chttp commit `a713d02bdbb19fa6f74bfb2293065d0771739ca0`, retaining its upstream
Apache-2.0 notices. It replaces the OpenSSL adapter with the existing SaltsUtils
4.3 Crypto API for RSA, ECDSA, EdDSA and HMAC. No JWE support is enabled.
The JWS-only interoperability vectors in `control/tests/jws_salts_vectors.h`
come from that same commit's `vendor/cjwt/tests/salts_vectors.h`; their keys are
disposable public test material generated by its `generate_salts_vectors.py`.
